subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: Should #43661 remain the concrete P0 Telegram satellite under #101863, or should maintainers nominate a narrower canonical issue for Telegram ambiguous-send and poisoned-session recovery?
rationale: Current main only partially mitigates compaction and outbound replay, while the remaining fix crosses run lifecycle, Telegram API limits, delivery durability, and recovery UX that need maintainer ownership before repair scope is safe.

options.title: Keep as P0 satellite
options.body: Leave #43661 open and linked to #101863 until end-to-end Telegram recovery proof closes the user-facing failure.

options.title: Create a narrower Telegram canonical
options.body: Move the ambiguous-send and poisoned-session recovery work to a dedicated canonical issue, then close #43661 only after that issue carries the same impact evidence.

options.title: Fold into the lifecycle umbrella
options.body: Close #43661 only if maintainers intentionally accept tracking this Telegram user-impact evidence solely through #101863.

recommendation.title: Keep as P0 satellite
recommendation.body: Leave #43661 open and linked to #101863 until end-to-end Telegram recovery proof closes the user-facing failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the broader lifecycle umbrella where the unresolved abort, release, crash-resume, and completion-drive choices are being designed.
